title: Turkish Airlines Stopover Program 2026: How the 20-Hour Free Hotel Works
seoTitle: Turkish Airlines Stopover 2026: Free Hotel Rules
metaDescription: How Turkish Airlines' 20-hour Istanbul Stopover works in 2026: 1 vs 2 free nights, exclusions, Touristanbul conflict, and when to book your own hotel.
quickAnswer: Turkish Airlines' 2026 Stopover in Istanbul program provides 1 free night in a 4-star hotel for Economy passengers—or 2 nights in a 5-star or boutique hotel for Business Class—on international round-trip tickets with a 20-hour to 7-day layover at IST. Airport transfers, visas, and early check-in are excluded, and you cannot combine it with Touristanbul.

body.text: Who qualifies for 1 vs 2 free hotel nights in Istanbul?

Under the official [Turkish Airlines Stopover in Istanbul rules](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-us/flights/stopover/), standard international round-trip passengers with a 20-hour to 7-day (168-hour) connection at Istanbul Airport (IST) receive 1 free night in a 4-star hotel in Economy or 2 free nights in a 5-star or boutique hotel in Business Class. Passengers originating from select long-haul markets receive an extra night.

Specifically, Turkish Airlines' published 2026 terms grant 2 free nights in Economy (4-star) and 3 free nights in Business Class (5-star or boutique) when your round-trip ticket's first departure country is the United States, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Taiwan, or Mainland China (excluding Hong Kong). All flights must be operated by Turkish Airlines (no codeshares), booked under a single round-trip reservation starting with ticket number 235, starting and ending in the same country, and excluding N and R fare classes. You must request your hotel voucher at least 72 hours before your first flight on that leg; walk-up applications after landing in Istanbul are not accepted.

body.text: What is excluded (airport transfers, visa, early check-in)?

The Stopover voucher covers room and breakfast only—nothing else. Passengers pay out of pocket for airport transfers between IST and the hotel, Turkish entry visas or e-Visas, early check-in or late check-out fees, extra meals, and local transit. Specific hotel requests are also not guaranteed; Turkish Airlines assigns partner hotels by quota.

Timing traps catch many travelers off guard. Standard hotel check-in (typically 14:00–15:00) and check-out (typically 12:00) still apply. If your long-haul flight lands at IST at 06:00, you cannot walk straight into your complimentary room without paying the hotel directly for early check-in—subject to availability. Likewise, if your layover exceeds 24 hours, you must clear customs and collect your checked luggage from IST international baggage claim rather than leaving it checked through.

items: Confirm your ticket starts with 235: Codeshare legs or separate one-way tickets disqualify the booking.
Apply at least 72 hours ahead: Use the online portal or your departure country's dedicated freehotel...@thy.com email on the [Stopover page](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-us/flights/stopover/).
Check entry visa requirements: Exiting IST into Türkiye requires meeting standard passport and e-Visa rules for your nationality.
Budget for IST ground transport: Allow 45–70 minutes each way between IST and central Istanbul depending on traffic.
Inspect your voucher check-in window: Once issued, the system will not swap your assigned hotel by personal preference.

body.text: Why can you NOT combine Stopover Hotel and Touristanbul on the same layover?

Turkish Airlines explicitly prohibits using both the Stopover Accommodation Service and [Touristanbul](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-us/flights/fly-different/touristanbul/) during the same layover period. Because both programs are tracked against your 235-ticket number and PNR, redeeming a free hotel voucher automatically locks out complimentary Touristanbul registration on that transit leg.

Note the single legitimate workaround for round-trip flyers: you can use the Stopover Hotel on one direction of your journey (outbound or inbound, since Stopover is limited to once per round-trip) and use Touristanbul on the opposite direction if that return layover falls between 6 and 24 hours.
When is booking your own central hotel smarter than using the free voucher?

Booking your own central hotel is often smarter when your arrival lands at 05:00–07:00 and you want guaranteed early check-in, when you want a specific neighborhood like Karaköy, Sultanahmet, or Nişantaşı, or when Turkish Airlines' quota assigns a peripheral highway hotel far from the Historic Peninsula.

If your stopover is only 22 hours and an assigned partner hotel sits 40 minutes away from sightseeing zones in heavy traffic, paying for a well-located boutique property—especially during quieter [winter months in Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/turkey-in-winter-premium-travel-guide) when central hotel rates drop—frequently yields double the usable city time and far better sleep.

faq.q: What is the difference between Turkish Airlines Stopover and the Transfer Hotel Service?
faq.a: The Stopover program is for voluntary 20-hour to 7-day layovers booked in advance (at least 72 hours ahead). The separate [Turkish Airlines Hotel Service](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-us/flights/hotel-service/) is for involuntary connections where no shorter connecting flight exists (12+ hours Economy, 9+ hours Business) and includes transfers.

faq.q: Can I use the Stopover hotel on a one-way Turkish Airlines ticket?
faq.a: No. Turkish Airlines requires a round-trip reservation where the journey begins and ends in the same country, with both outbound and return flights under one reservation.

faq.q: Can I choose which hotel Turkish Airlines gives me?
faq.a: You may see available partner options in the booking portal, but specific properties are never guaranteed and depend on Turkish Airlines' seasonal room quotas. Once issued, vouchers cannot be changed.

faq.q: What happens to my checked baggage on a 20–24 hour vs. 24+ hour Stopover?
faq.a: If your Istanbul layover exceeds 24 hours, you must collect your checked baggage at IST international arrivals and re-check it before your onward flight. Under 24 hours, confirm with your departure check-in agent whether bags are tagged through.

faq.q: Can I extend my stay at the Stopover hotel for extra nights?
faq.a: Yes. After receiving your official hotel voucher, you can contact the assigned hotel directly to book extra nights at Turkish Airlines' contracted partner rates, subject to availability.

faq.q: Do award tickets or Miles&Smiles bookings qualify for Stopover?
faq.a: Eligibility depends on fare class—tickets issued in N and R fare classes are excluded, and all legs must be TK-operated on 235-ticket stock. Always check your PNR in the official Stopover portal before assuming coverage.
